> /kind feature

/kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

PR https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/77906 allows Kubelet to run with no Azure identity:

> Kubelet could be run with no Azure identity now. A sample cloud provider configure is:  `{"vmType": "vmss", "useInstanceMetadata": true, "subscriptionId": "<subscriptionId>"}`

But actually, subscriptionId could also be got from IMDS. 

Also, when getting availability zones, `location` from IMDS should be used instead of cloud-config file:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/2974adff27619bb27a27a78bd61de772a2d65bef/staging/src/k8s.io/legacy-cloud-providers/azure/azure_zones.go#L75-L77

This PR fixes those issues by getting location and subscriptionId from IMDS.

issue_context.title: "location" and "subscriptionId" should get got from Azure IMDS when useInstanceMetadata is true
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:

PR https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/77906 allows Kubelet to run with no Azure identity:

> Kubelet could be run with no Azure identity now. A sample cloud provider configure is:  `{"vmType": "vmss", "useInstanceMetadata": true, "subscriptionId": "<subscriptionId>"}`

But actually, subscriptionId could also be got from IMDS. 

Also, when getting availability zones, `location` from IMDS should be used instead of cloud-config file:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/2974adff27619bb27a27a78bd61de772a2d65bef/staging/src/k8s.io/legacy-cloud-providers/azure/azure_zones.go#L75-L77

**What you expected to happen**:

Only `{"vmType": "vmss", "useInstanceMetadata": true}` is required for Kubelet running on Azure.
